app.title: E-means: Outperforming k-means in one-tenth the epochs
app.description: A lightweight implementation of the E-means clustering algorithm that claims to converge faster than traditional k-means.
proposed_tests: Run a quick clustering on the Iris dataset and verify cluster counts
Measure runtime vs scikit-learn k-means on the same dataset
Check reproducibility by setting random seed and ensuring consistent results
Validate that the algorithm returns centroids with expected dimensionality
